title: 🔬 My Team Is Now Research
notes: 🔬 My Team is now Research. Everything that was there lives under Overview.
📈 New Outlook view: record and ranks, playoff odds from 2,000 simulated seasons, luck vs. all-play, and your last-3 scoring.
🗓️ Up Next shows your next four opponents with their form, injuries and your win chance.
🧱 Position Rooms grade your healthy starters at QB, RB, WR and TE against the league and count real depth.
🩹 Injury Luck shows starter games and points lost to injury and where that ranks.
🔮 Dynasty Window: your window, roster value rank, age vs. the league, and value three years out.
